description: This file defines interfaces for a GStreamer-based media player, including factory and player classes, with methods for media source management, playback control, and configuration.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IGstGenericPlayer.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayer
classes.description: Interface for a GStreamer-based media player with methods for media control and configuration.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the factory instance.

methods.name: createGstGenericPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new IGstGenericPlayer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the player.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the player.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Notifies that all sources have been attached.

methods.name: setVideoGeometry
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle position and size.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Queues an end-of-stream notification for a media source.

methods.name: attachSamples
methods.description: Attaches media samples or data reader to the player.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets or seeks to a specific playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Requests rendering of a pre-rolled frame.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Sets the mute state of the audio pipeline.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves the mute state of the audio pipeline.
